title: A Christmas Reunion
start: Talk to Diango in the Land of Snow's Christmas Village.

ironman.t: 32 Cooking to start Chef's Assistant (to obtain biscuits)
38 Cooking Boostable (to make a pat of butter for the biscuits, unless obtained from the Culinaromancer's Chest)

items.t: Thread (can be omitted with the effect from a Crafting cape)

rewards.t: Prismatic XP lamp yielding 5,000 experience in a skill of choice
Green, red, and white Winter Hat and Winter Scarf (if not unlocked)
Emotes from previous Christmas events (if not unlocked)
Access to the hot chocolate brewing and toy production activities in the Christmas Village

steps.t: Talk to Cait or Diango in Christmas Village. [Chat: Accept]
Fully build the three piles of planks.
Talk to Cait or Diango in Christmas Village.
Talk to three of the pixies found in the following areas. You can optionally scan with the magical thingymabob for status indicators for how close you are to the correct spot.
p: A player activates the magical thingymabob.

steps.t: Talk to Cait or Diango in Christmas Village. [Chat: Any]
Talk to Iffie in Varrock. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'A Christmas Reunion'. › Any]
Use red dye on green dye. [Chat: 1 Make Christmas dye.]
Talk to Cait or Diango in Christmas Village. [Chat: Any]
Add hot chocolate powder to the hot chocolate storage and enter "0", "2", and "3" when prompted.
Add biscuits to the biscuit storage and enter "1", "2", and "2" when prompted.
Talk to Cait or Diango in Christmas Village.

get_inside.text: Christmas Village Teleport in any Magic spellbook or via the Lodestone Network.
Christmas Village portal north of the Grand Exchange.
Holiday portal in Tower of Voices.
Using the teleport option of Christmas wrapping paper, letter to Santa, or town crier.
Using the teleport option in the Calendar or event interfaces.
